property_summary: For any caller address X and newOwner Y, when X is the current owner the reference contract always allows setOwner(Y) to succeed (owner becomes Y); the mutant that additionally requires tx.origin == owner prevents calls that originate from a different tx.origin even if msg.sender == owner (e.g., when owner is a contract), thus breaking this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Insert an additional require in onlyOwner that also requires tx.origin == owner, making the guard stricter and changing which calls to setOwner succeed.
